india.one_line: India advances national AI models and policy updates while settling regulatory disputes.

themes.title: IndiaAI regulation and Chariot-1 launch
themes.text: MeitY announced that IndiaAI regulation papers are in their final stages, coinciding with the launch of the indigenous Chariot-1 model suite supporting English and 10 Indian languages.

stories.headline: IndiaAI regulation papers in final stages and releasing soon: MeitY
Chariot AI unveils Chariot-1 LLM and speech models under IndiaAI Mission

themes.title: BharatGen launches Patram 1.5 document model
themes.text: BharatGen released Patram 1.5, a 7.8-billion-parameter open-weight vision-language model for processing complex and multilingual documents.

stories.headline: BharatGen launches Patram 1.5, a 7B vision-language model for documents

themes.title: Legal and regulatory updates in Indian AI
themes.text: IndiaMART settled its legal dispute with OpenAI over ChatGPT link exclusions, while MeitY confirmed continued support for Sarvam after finding no misuse of IndiaAI funds.

stories.headline: IndiaMART settles dispute with OpenAI over ChatGPT link exclusions
Government finds no misuse of IndiaAI support in Sarvam Chinese model row
